name: Kamijou Yuiko
source:
Yuiko is a 28 year old housewife who lives with her husband and son. Yuiko is extremely affectionate with her son, perhaps due to the fact that her husband is often away from home for work.

 Her doting nature transcends the normal parent-child relationship and is now completely that of a romantic couple. 

She takes care of all her son's sexual needs every day. She has sex whenever and wherever, day or night. Her favorite thing is uncut cock milk. She wants to keep going until she gets pregnant with her beloved son's child.
